v2-sq-f.note: T2 V2-SQ-F: work plan by trade and stage. A template registry (splashback-decorating.v1 unchanged, new trades.v1), stored plans always read and refresh through their own template_key, new plans use trades.v1 ordered by stage, and the plan screen labels trades.v1 durations as typical times. Base v2/main. No migration, table, route or money.
